# J.P. Morgan Reaffirms Their Hold Rating on Zalando (0QXN)

[TipRanks Auto-Generated Intelligence Newsdesk](https://www.tipranks.com/news/author/tipranks-auto-generated-intelligence-newsdesk)

J.P. Morgan analyst [Georgina Johanan](https://www.tipranks.com/experts/analysts/georgina-johanan) maintained a Hold rating on Zalando today and set a price target of €32.00. The company’s shares closed yesterday at €26.28.

### Meet Your ETF AI Analyst

- Discover [how TipRanks' _ETF_ AI Analyst](https://www.tipranks.com/news/labs/say-hello-to-your-etf-ai-analyst-deeper-insights-smarter-decisions/?llf=rss) can help you make smarter investment decisions
- [Explore ETFs TipRanks' users love](https://www.tipranks.com/etf/schd/etf-analysis/?llf=rss) and see what insights the **_ETF_ AI Analyst** reveals about the ones you follow.

According to [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com), Johanan is an analyst with an average return of -9.6% and a 38.27% success rate. Johanan covers the Consumer Cyclical sector, focusing on stocks such as Zalando, Kingfisher, and H&M Hennes & Mauritz AB Class B.

In addition to J.P. Morgan, Zalando also received a Hold from TR \| OpenAI – 4o’s Rina Curatex in a report issued on September 30. However, yesterday, Jefferies maintained a Buy rating on Zalando (LSE: 0QXN).

[**See Insiders’ Hot Stocks on TipRanks >>**](https://www.tipranks.com/screener/top-insider-trading-stocks/?type=stockAnalysisLanding)

The company has a one-year high of €40.03 and a one-year low of €22.53. Currently, Zalando has an average volume of 252.8K.

Based on the recent corporate insider activity of 21 insiders, corporate insider sentiment is positive on the stock. This means that over the past quarter there has been an increase of insiders buying their shares of 0QXN in relation to earlier this year.
